newsitem.title: USA: Snap-On No. America sales rise in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Snap-On No. America sales rise in 1996.

text.p: Snap-On Inc said Wednesday its North American sales rose five percent in 1996 compared with 1995 levels, excluding acquisitions, and increased 10.5 percent overall.
European base business revenues were up eight percent and increased 46.7 percent including acquisitions.

Earlier, Snap-On reported record full-year 1996 sales of $1.49 billion, up from $1.29 billion a year ago. Earnings for the year were a record $131.5 million, a $2.16 a share, compared with year-ago earnings of $113.3 million or $1.84.
Operating expenses in 1996 were 40.0 percent of sales, compared with 41.6 percent in 1995.
For the fourth quarter, it had sales of $36.5 million and earnings of $0.60 a share. Fourth quarter 1995 sales were $30.8 million and earnings of $0.51 a share.
Snap-On makes and distributes hand and power tools, diagnostic hardware and software, shop equipment and tool storage products.
